mechanism: Read the kernel-checked identity as a renewal/Neumann structure: sourceHighPrefix is the finite sum over generations j of sourceHighGenerationPrefix (Lean: sourceHighPrefix_eq_generation_sum), where generation j+1 is the high-projected forcing operator P_high∘F applied to generation j, and the six-term signed Gram value is exactly the window energy of this Neumann partial sum. Instead of bounding the forcing operator in operator norm (which is the documented failure mode of obstacle 4), bound the special-vector Rayleigh quotient along the Krylov orbit of the arithmetic root: prove the Generation-Orbit Contraction (GOC-ρ) that the window energies E_j = windowPathEnergy H (sourceHighGenerationWindowPath Λ B j N) satisfy E_{j+1} ≤ ρ·E_j with a uniform ρ < 1, sourced from the wheel structure. The pinned primorial start L_k = W_{k-1} makes every residue class of the wheel modulus Q_k complete at block-aligned samples, so the zero-frequency self-coupling of F is subtracted exactly (not approximately), and the packet's contraction factor ρ_{k,n} = (X_n−L_k)/Q_k < 1/6 is the coupling mass remaining on the nonzero-frequency sector; the claim is that this scalar factor upgrades to an energy contraction on the specific high-projected orbit vectors via a Schur test on the exact wheel-projected kernel restricted to the admissible arithmetic cone (Möbius-weighted combs on wheel-coprime residues). Given GOC-ρ, the triangle inequality in ℓ²(window) over generations gives ‖Σ_j g_j‖ ≤ ‖g_0‖/(1−√ρ), so the entire target reduces to the single ROOT estimate: E_0(Λ,B,N,H) ≤ C_ε H N^{2+ε} for the generation-0 vector, which is the PNT-centered all-plus comb minus its exact wheel expectation — an object where the C−2E correlation is carried inside one vector by identity, positivity is available on the C-side, and sieve upper bounds with constant losses (Montgomery–Vaughan/Selberg prime-pair upper bounds for the bounded-length windows |q−c| ≲ Λ arising from the height cutoff |q²−c²| ≤ 2Λj) are admissible because the target constant C is unconstrained. The loss factor through the resolvent step is the explicit constant (1−1/√6)^{-2} ≈ 2.9, absorbed into C.
new_leverage: Two things a standard spectral application would not do. First, orbit restriction: the closing inequality is the Rayleigh quotient of the forcing operator evaluated only on its own Krylov orbit started at the arithmetic root — exactly the quantity the six-term signed Gram identity preserves and the quantity that entrywise absolute-value bounds (the documented obstacle-4 failure) strictly overestimate; the gap between the too-large operator norm and the orbit Rayleigh quotient is the entire content. Second, the pinned synchronized start is used as an asset, not averaged over: at L_k = W_{k-1} the wheel residue system is complete, so zero-mode elimination is an exact algebraic subtraction (kernel-checkable, no Siegel–Walfisz uniformity in the growing modulus Q_k needed), leaving the contraction claim to live entirely on the nonzero-frequency sector where the 1/6 factor is declared. Standard spectral practice (operator norm + generic start) fails on both counts by the packet's own obstacles.
target_estimate: (GOC-ρ): for each Λ ≥ 0 there is ρ = ρ(Λ) < 1 (conjecturally ≤ 1/6 + o(1) from the wheel coupling) such that for all N ≥ H ≥ 1, B = windowSourceBound N H, and all j < B: windowPathEnergy H (sourceHighGenerationWindowPath Λ B (j+1) N) ≤ ρ · windowPathEnergy H (sourceHighGenerationWindowPath Λ B j N), uniformly at the pinned block starts. Plus (ROOT): for every ε > 0 there is C_ε with E_0(Λ,B,N,H) ≤ C_ε · H · N^{2+ε}, proved by exact wheel-expectation subtraction at complete residue systems plus unconditional sieve upper bounds (constant loss allowed) for prime pairs in the bounded windows |q−c| ≤ 2Λ+O(1) induced by the height cutoff. Together these give ProjectedRenewalQuadraticBoundedStatement Λ with C = C_ε·(1−√ρ)^{-2}, i.e., total loss a factor ≈ 2.9·C_ε at ρ = 1/6.

obstacle_positions.pinned_vs_averaged: Used as leverage, not evaded: the primorial start makes the wheel residue system complete at block-aligned samples, so zero-mode subtraction is exact algebra rather than an equidistribution estimate; no exceptional-set language appears anywhere, and H = 1 admissibility means the angle claims nothing from window averaging.
obstacle_positions.large_sieve_non_transfer: Not invoked. There is one modulus (the wheel Q_k) at one scale; the operator bound is a single-scale Schur/Rayleigh estimate on the exact kernel. The obstacle's shadow reappears as the risk that nonzero-frequency row sums are not < 1 in operator norm — which is exactly why the claim retreats to the orbit Rayleigh quotient, the quantity the kill test measures.
obstacle_positions.not_bombieri_vinogradov: Agreed and respected: no residue-class-to-varying-modulus averaging is used. The reciprocal-d family enters only inside the ROOT vector, handled by the exact C−2E identity within one vector, not by BV-style dispersion over moduli.
obstacle_positions.strong_induction_failure: The scheme never inserts |M(d)| ≤ Kd^{1/2+ε} entrywise; Mertens data feeds back only quadratically through window energies of the actual orbit vectors, and the closing quantity is an energy ratio on the special vector — strictly smaller than the row-sum operator that provably fails. If GOC-ρ holds, no induction on M is needed at all.
obstacle_positions.parity: The contraction step is combinatorial (wheel coupling mass), not sieve-theoretic, so parity does not obstruct it. Parity risk is concentrated in ROOT: the C-side needs only sieve upper bounds with constant loss (parity-safe); the residual E-component of the root is the acknowledged danger — if generation 0 still carries full π(x)−Li(x) mass, parity/RH-hardness has been shuffled, not removed. Position: parity is avoided in the operator step, unresolved in the root step.
obstacle_positions.finite_range_deception: The numerics below are used only as a falsifier, never as evidence; the affirmative path is exact per-generation inequalities from kernel-checkable wheel algebra plus one analytic root input. The kill test deliberately samples at primorial block crossings, the exact locations where near-flat empirical exponents are most deceptive.

kill_test: Exact integer computation (from sourceHighPrefix_eq_sum, reimplementable in Python in an afternoon) of the generation energies E_j(Λ,B,N,H) and ratios E_{j+1}/E_j for Λ ∈ {0, 1, 4}, N from 16 to ~512 spanning at least one primorial block crossing (W_4 = 210, W_5 = 2310, i.e., n ≈ 14 and n ≈ 47), H ∈ {1, N/2}, B = windowSourceBound N H. If max_j E_{j+1}/E_j ≥ 1 persistently — in particular at synchronized block crossings — the orbit-contraction claim (GOC-ρ) is dead and the angle with it. A second cheap probe: compute the Rayleigh quotient ⟨g_j, F g_j⟩/‖g_j‖² directly to see whether contraction, if present, comes from the 1/6 wheel factor or from accidental small-scale cancellation.
rung0_plan: At o(x)/PNT strength the orbit refinement is unnecessary: prove the operator-norm version of GOC — ‖P_high F P_high‖ ≤ ρ₀ < 1 on the zero-mode-free wheel sector by a plain Schur row-sum test on the exact kernel (any ρ₀ < 1 works, e.g. 6/7; constant losses are affordable at this rung) — and bound the root at PNT strength: generation 0 minus its exact wheel expectation is o(N²) per sample using only PNT for the Li-centering, since the zero-mode subtraction at complete residue systems is exact algebra and needs no character-sum uniformity in Q_k. Neumann summation then gives the high prefix o(n²) = o(x), i.e., the same machinery closes at Mertens o(x). If even this rung-0 Schur bound fails numerically, the angle fails its own viability control.
plausible_partial: Realistically provable at bounded effort: (a) a kernel-checked reduction theorem "GOC-ρ ∧ ROOT ⇒ ProjectedRenewalQuadraticBoundedStatement Λ" with the explicit (1−√ρ)^{-2} constant — pure algebra over the existing Lean identities; (b) an unconditional explicit Schur row-sum bound for ‖P_high F P_high‖ on the zero-mode-free sector at the pinned starts, settling the rung-0 operator question one way or the other; (c) the kill-test dataset of orbit energy ratios across two primorial crossings. NOT plausible at bounded effort: any new unconditional exponent θ < 1 for M(x) itself — that is open independently of this framework (equivalent to a zero-free strip), so claiming rung 1 as a deliverable would be overclaiming; the honest partial is the fully-verified conditional reduction isolating the analytic content into ROOT, plus a numerical verdict on GOC-ρ.
self_assessed_risk: The assumption most likely false is GOC-ρ in vector form: the declared ρ_{k,n} < 1/6 is a scalar coupling factor for the zero-frequency self-coupling, and it may simply not upgrade to an ℓ²-energy contraction of the full high-projected forcing on the actual orbit — the nonzero-frequency sector can carry energy ratio ≥ 1 even with exact zero-mode elimination. Secondary risk, equally fatal: ROOT may secretly contain the full π(x)−Li(x) discrepancy at strength making it RH-equivalent, in which case the resolvent step is a tautological transfer, not a reduction. Both claims are UNVERIFIED professional speculation; the kill test attacks the first directly and partially probes the second (via the size of E_0 against H·N^{2+ε} numerically).
